messages:
alice.devex: Quick sync — building Q3 DevEx roadmap. Focus areas: SDK ergonomics (py/ts), quickstarts for embeddings & chat, 1-2 sample apps (realtime chat, batch ingest). Need to prioritize based on customer asks and launch criteria. Thoughts?

ben.product: +1. Customer A asked for typed TS SDK and examples. Customer B needs offline batch embedding quickstart. We should pick the ones that unblock paid adoption.

eva.docs: From docs POV we need 2 quickstarts: 'embeddings-batch' and 'chat-streaming'. Each must have end-to-end config, sample prompt sets, and cost estimation section. Estimate 3 docs writer-weeks each.

dylan.eng: Engineering constraints: py SDK major refactor is medium risk; can we ship a compatibility shim? Also runtime needs a helper for streaming tokens -> callback. If we scope to v1.1 (compat shim + new API surface) we can hit Q3.

carmen.se: Customer asks prioritized: 1) typed TS SDK + examples, 2) offline embeddings quickstart, 3) sample app for vector search at scale. All require SLA notes.

alice.devex: Proposed prioritization: 1) TS SDK + quickstart (high), 2) embeddings batch quickstart + sample (med), 3) py SDK follow-up (low for now). Launch criteria: (a) sample app with CI + demo script, (b) docs + cost calc, (c) 2 customer signoffs or 1 pilot with enterprise.

roadmap-bot: New OKR card created: DevEx-Q3-SDKs-1769994321 — owners: @alice.devex, @dylan.eng. Link: https://redwood.example/okrs/DevEx-Q3-SDKs-1769994321

ben.product: Agree with launch criteria. Add: runbench for streaming latencies < 200ms token median for demo dataset.

eva.docs: I'll draft the quickstart templates by Mon. Can we create a 'cost-estimate' script in samples repo? small CLI tool that prints expected tokens/cost. Pseudocode:
```
$ python cost_estimate.py --model redwood-medium --tokens 5000
Estimated cost: $2.35
```

alice.devex: Action items:
- @dylan.eng: compatibility shim + streaming callback (ETA 2w)
- @eva.docs: quickstart drafts + cost script (ETA 1w)
- @ben.product: secure customer pilot signoff (ETA 2w)
- @carmen.se: prepare pilot checklist and SLA pointer
We'll review next Tue 10am PT. :calendar:

dylan.eng: Noted. I'll open PRs and link CI. If we hit blockers I'll ping here.

carmen.se: I'll schedule pilot outreach. FYI legal needs SLA template by EoQ.

alice.devex: cool. Let's keep tickets in the DevEx board and tag 'Q3-critical'. :thumbsup:
